Package org.moddingx.libx.menu.type

Interface AdvancedMenuFactory<T extends net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu,S>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of menu created by this factory.
S - The type of the extra payload used to create menus. This can be Void.
public interface AdvancedMenuFactory<T extends net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu,S>
A factory for menus that can take some kind of extra payload.
